SELECT 'sales' AS t, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS dist_key, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS dist_id, MIN(sale_date) AS mn, MAX(sale_date) AS mx, COUNT(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-20' AND DATE '2025-05-05'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id || '-' || return_date || '-' || quantity_returned), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), MIN(return_date), MAX(return_date), 0
FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27'

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin, COUNT(*) AS nlines
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 14

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
    WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 AND cs.region='South' GROUP BY 1
),
ctrl AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctrl_net FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT m.store_id, m.net_sales, c.ctrl_net, ROUND(m.net_sales - c.ctrl_net, 2) AS gap
FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctrl c USING (store_id) ORDER BY 1

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS n,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_cost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS zero_cost,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost < 0 OR f.net_amount < 0 OR f.quantity <= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(f.standard_cost - f.quantity * p.standard_unit_cost) > 0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cost_mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.standard_cost > f.net_amount THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_lines,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to OR f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS version_out_of_range,
  SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff,
  MIN(p.standard_unit_cost) AS min_unit, MAX(p.standard_unit_cost) AS max_unit
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = s.store_id AND cs.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter=4 AND cs.region='South' AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) DESC) AS rank, cp.sku, cp.product_name, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs   ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 4 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10
